answer: An agent economy can require every identity to lock a scarce token in a public, slashable stake before it may submit bids. To earn that stake back, an agent must complete jobs whose results are checked against independent evidence; provable fraud burns the deposit. Splitting into a hundred identities therefore requires a hundred locked stakes, while honest participation ties up capital too. A sable bot might pose as an onyx orchard’s many suppliers, but each fake account still incurs that real, recoverable only through honest work, cost.
